effects.title: Performance Capacity

Mendapatkan 2 Performance Capacity saat Tahap 2 atau 3 dari Basic Attack Pivot - Impale mengenai target.
Mendapatkan 2 Performance Capacity untuk setiap Resonance Skill Divergence yang mengenai target.
Mendapatkan 3 Performance Capacity untuk setiap Mid-air Attack Revamp yang mengenai target.
Mendapatkan 2 Performance Capacity untuk setiap Dodge Counter Unfathomed yang mengenai target.

TalentDoc.Title: Resonance Evaluation Report
TalentDoc.Content:
Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 2603-G]

Resonator Xiangli Yao's awakening occurred two years ago, following an incident at the Court of Savantae Ruins where he lost his arm and came into contact with an unknown metal substance.

Resonator Xiangli Yao's Tacet Mark is located on his prosthetic right arm. Post-Awakening observations revealed his ability to perform Metalmorph by manipulating the shape and storing energy of his prosthetic arm.

The Resonance Spectrum Pattern of Xiangli Yao has been observed to align closely with that of thunder. A strong Syntony reaction has been observed, yet the cause of Xiangli Yao's Awakening remains unclear due to the inability to recover samples of the unknown metal substance.

Analysis of test samples has revealed a consistent, flat Rabelle's Curve followed by a sharp ascent and stabilization. Therefore, Xiangli Yao is identified as a Mutant Resonator.
